title: Regularity of an ideal descends along a flat local ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is a descent statement for regularity of an ideal along a flat local homomorphism, and its proof is a 50-line argument that follows the classical route through the Koszul complex. It fixes a prime containing the ideal, reduces to the local situation, and compares the Koszul homology before and after base change using the flatness of the map and the flat base change statement for Koszul homology proved in the same chapter. The reduction to the prime-local situation and the identification of the two Koszul complexes are both written out, so the proof is self-contained apart from the standard inputs it names.
